description: This file contains CSS styles for managing themes in a React application, including light and dark modes through CSS variables.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container that centers the content and sets background color based on the current theme.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header for the application that organizes elements in a flexible column layout.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styled link element within the application that changes color on hover.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling between light and dark themes with various hover and active states.
